svg.text: Central Park: every Polyfork made thing (overhead plan, north up)
Today's park from data/world.json. Grey = what is already there. Colours = the new pieces: 1008 in all, 528k triangles. Grass, trees and bushes stay ours.

The brook runs out of the big lake (NE corner, most of it past the forcefield) down to the pond.
